items.q: Do I need insurance for my landscaping business?
items.a: Yes. Most clients and municipalities require proof of general liability before you can work on their property.
It covers property damage you cause at a job site, injuries to non-employees, and legal defense costs if you're sued.

items.q: How fast can I get a certificate of insurance?
items.a: Usually within 24 hours of binding your policy. I know you need COIs fast to land jobs.

items.q: Can you cover my seasonal workers?
items.a: Yes. Workers' comp policies can be structured to account for seasonal fluctuations in your crew size.
